Biggest Movers Since Preseason

Change in rank, preseason → latest poll. Green = surged, purple = slipped. 🔥 = a preseason-unranked team that climbed into the Top 25 by 5+ spots.

Steady Hands & Roller Coasters

Every team's average rank vs. its rank volatility (how much its ranking swung, week to week). Up & right = elite and consistent; down = unpredictable. High volatility isn't bad — it's unstable.

Tip: click a conference to isolate it — click All to bring everyone back.

Upset Tracker

Every time a lower-ranked or unranked team took down a ranked one. Gap = the rank gap they overcame; a highlighted card marks an unranked giant-killer, and 💥 a comfortable win (10+ points).

Source: polls_analytics.csv + polls_games_joined.csv in kbsmd-sportsmusicdata/wbb_polls_pbp_2026. Weekly progression (table_id=2) unioned with final standings (table_id=1); upsets from the joined games table. Logos from data/assets; a colored monogram stands in where a logo isn't bundled yet. Rank 26 = unranked. A prototype by Claude Design.
